verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Version History feature that lets designers access and preview all saved versions, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions, which covers restore and roughly covers milestones. The docs do not show that saved versions can be named or that two versions can be compared side by side; previewing is not comparing. missing for 10: explicit naming of milestone versions, side-by-side version comparison or diffing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, full version history lets me name milestones, compare, and restore any earlier state of a file

citations.quote: Version History allows you to access and preview all the saved versions of your files. This feature helps you track changes, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions as needed.
